title: Josiah’s Reforms

questions.question: How old was Josiah when he began to reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 34:1 (ESV): "Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign..."

questions.question: What did Josiah do in the eighth year of his reign?
options: He began to seek the God of David his father
questions.correctAnswer: He began to seek the God of David his father
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 34:3 (ESV): "For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet a boy, he began to seek the God of David his father..."

questions.question: What happened while they were cleansing the temple?
options: Hilkiah the priest found the Book of the Law of the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: Hilkiah the priest found the Book of the Law of the LORD
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 34:14 (ESV): "...Hilkiah the priest found the Book of the Law of the LORD given through Moses."

questions.question: How did Josiah react when he heard the words of the Law?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 34:19 (ESV): "And when the king heard the words of the Law, he tore his clothes."

questions.question: To whom did they go to inquire of the LORD?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 34:22 (ESV): "So... they went to Huldah the prophetess..."

questions.question: What did Huldah prophesy?
options: Disaster on this place, but Josiah would be gathered to his grave in peace
questions.correctAnswer: Disaster on this place, but Josiah would be gathered to his grave in peace
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 34:24-28 (ESV): "...I will bring disaster upon this place... But to the king of Judah... Behold, I will gather you to your fathers... in peace..."

questions.question: Why would Josiah be spared the disaster?
options: Because his heart was tender and he humbled himself
questions.correctAnswer: Because his heart was tender and he humbled himself
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 34:27 (ESV): "Because your heart was tender and you humbled yourself before God..."

questions.question: What did Josiah do with the Book of the Covenant?
options: He read in their hearing all the words of the Book
questions.correctAnswer: He read in their hearing all the words of the Book
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 34:30 (ESV): "...And he read in their hearing all the words of the Book of the Covenant..."

questions.question: What covenant did the king make?
options: To walk after the LORD and to keep his commandments with all his heart and soul
questions.correctAnswer: To walk after the LORD and to keep his commandments with all his heart and soul
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 34:31 (ESV): "And the king stood in his place and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD..."

questions.question: Did the people serve the LORD during Josiah's days?
options: Yes, they did not turn away from following the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: Yes, they did not turn away from following the LORD
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 34:33 (ESV): "...All his days they did not turn away from following the LORD..."

questions.question: In which year of his reign did he begin to purge Judah and Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 34:3 (ESV): "...and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem..."

questions.question: Who broke down the altars of the Baals?
options: They broke them down in his (Josiah's) presence
questions.correctAnswer: They broke them down in his (Josiah's) presence
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 34:4 (ESV): "And they chopped down the altars of the Baals in his presence..."

questions.question: What did he do with the crushed dust of the idols?
options: He scattered it over the graves of those who had sacrificed to them
He threw it in the river
questions.correctAnswer: He scattered it over the graves of those who had sacrificed to them
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 34:4 (ESV): "...and made dust of them and scattered it over the graves of those who had sacrificed to them."

questions.question: Who was Shaphan?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 34:15 (ESV): "And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the secretary..."

questions.question: Where did Huldah live?
options: In Jerusalem in the Second Quarter
questions.correctAnswer: In Jerusalem in the Second Quarter
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 34:22 (ESV): "...Now she lived in Jerusalem in the Second Quarter..."

key_verse_text: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD, and walked in the ways of David his father; and he did not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
